Name: Luny's Recolors for HxW Buildable Bakery (for Alternative Textures)
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]

I recently installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28031]HxW Bakery shed[/url] and it's so fluffin cute! I love it! (´꒳`)♡ But the colors just didn't match the other buildings on my farm, so I asked permission to create some recolors based on popular building mods﻿. And permission was granted! °˖✧◝(⁰▿⁰)◜✧˖° One ADHD-powered night later, I finished the first two recolor options!
I know most people have seen HxW's mods already, but if you haven't, definitely check them out! They make so many cute and amazing mods! [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts/about-me?gameId=1303]HimeTarts[/url] & [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods/about-me?gameId=1303]Wildflourmods[/url]﻿.

[b]Currently this pack contains recolors based on:[/b]
1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings by Gweniaczek[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings

[/url][b]Planned recolors to add:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16852]Tanga Forest Buildings[/url]

If you have a building mod you'd like to request a recolor for, feel free to leave a comment with the name and a link if possible. I can't guarantee I'll add it, but it'll definitely be on my radar for additions.

[b]Known issues:[/b]
For some reason, the preview image in AT's interface only shows the texture for Spring, with the other seasons just displaying a line. The textures apply to the building perfectly fine, and I haven't seen any other issues while testing, including when the season changes. I'm not sure why the preview image is messed up, so if anyone knows what's up with that, please let me know.
You can look at the number listed at the end of the building name at the bottom of the interface to know which texture is which. 1 is Medieval, 2 is Overgrown. I've added numbers to the textures list above for easier reference.

Move the folder "[AT] HxW Bakery Shed Recolors by Luny" into your StardewValley/mods folder.
Done![/center]
